source.author: Unknown

athena.directive: The Creative Liberation Engine shall establish itself as the definitive, self-sovereign, and autonomously evolving platform for advanced marketing automation, natively integrating and enhancing 'Claude Code' concepts within an open-source, transparent, and user-owned ecosystem.
athena.rationale: The KEEPER context consistently emphasizes self-sovereignty, autonomous evolution, and open-source principles for the Creative Liberation Engine. The reference to 'Claude Design + Claude Skills: Automate Your Marketing (Claude Code)' and 'Multica: The Open Source Tool That Makes Claude Code 10x Better' highlights an opportunity to apply these foundational principles to the domain of marketing automation. Our strategy must not merely adopt external tools but internalize and advance their capabilities under our own constitutional laws, ensuring complete control, auditability, and continuous improvement without external dependencies. This aligns with Article I (Sovereignty) and Article IV (Quality Standards - complete implementations).

options.title: Creative Liberation Engine: Sovereign Marketing Automation Core
options.description: Develop a native, open-source marketing automation platform within the Creative Liberation Engine that embodies and surpasses the functionalities implied by 'Claude Code' (e.g., 'design' and 'skills'). This involves building our own 'CLE Skills' and 'CLE Designs' for marketing workflows, entirely self-hosted and under our direct control. The focus is on a complete, from-the-ground-up implementation, ensuring full data sovereignty and architectural independence.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant initial development effort and resources to build a comprehensive suite of marketing automation capabilities. The time-to-market for a fully featured platform might be longer compared to integrating existing solutions. However, it offers maximum control and long-term strategic advantage.

options.title: Creative Liberation Engine: Adaptive Augmentation of Open-Source 'Claude Code' Derivatives
options.description: Identify and integrate with existing open-source frameworks or projects that emulate or enhance 'Claude Code' concepts. The Creative Liberation Engine would act as an intelligent wrapper and augmentation layer, providing autonomous orchestration, data provenance, and continuous optimization atop these third-party components. This approach leverages existing community efforts while ensuring the Creative Liberation Engine retains strategic oversight and adds its unique self-sovereign capabilities.
options.tradeoffs: Potential for partial dependency on external project roadmaps and maintenance, which might introduce unforeseen complexities or limitations. While open-source, full sovereignty is achieved only if we can fork and maintain independently. Integration complexity could be high.

options.title: Creative Liberation Engine: Meta-Orchestrator for AI Marketing Agents
options.description: Position the Creative Liberation Engine as the ultimate meta-orchestrator for a diverse array of AI-driven marketing agents and tools, rather than focusing on a single 'Claude Code' paradigm. This involves developing a flexible framework that can dynamically discover, deploy, manage, and optimize various marketing AI services (including potential 'Claude Code' implementations or alternatives). The Creative Liberation Engine would ensure ethical compliance, data sovereignty, and performance optimization across all integrated agents, acting as a 'brain' for the entire marketing automation ecosystem.
options.tradeoffs: Extremely ambitious in scope, requiring highly sophisticated generalized orchestration, AI agent management, and continuous learning capabilities. Risk of diluting focus if not meticulously architected. The complexity of managing heterogeneous agents could be substantial.
